gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules print sale of assets inside receipts: General Fund 'Local' 855,602 (p10) = Local 838,755 + Sale of assets 16,847 (p7 combining statement), and Road Fund 'Local' 210,438 (p12) = Local 44,493 + Sale of assets 165,945 (p5). detail[] follows them (index 3 Sale of assets 16,847; index 45 Sale of assets 165,945, section revenue). The governmental funds statement (p5-6) prints Sale of assets 16,847 + 165,945 = 182,792 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), outside TOTAL RECEIPTS 9,546,790 (JSON other_financing 182,792). 9,729,582 - 182,792 = 9,546,790. Both are printed classifications; no line is missing or duplicated.

detail records transfers gross per sub-fund from the combining statements: General 519,689 + Inheritance Tax 30,000 (p7), Road 2,445,000 (p12), 911 Emergency Services 15,818 (p8), Opioid Recovery 6,594 (p9) = 3,017,101. The governmental funds statement (p5-6) prints the combined General Fund column and the Non-Major Funds column with transfers between their own sub-funds eliminated: General Fund Transfers - in 49,689 (= 549,689 - 500,000 Inheritance Tax Fund to General) and Non-Major 6,594 (= 22,412 - 15,818 911 Wireless to 911 Emergency Services), total 2,501,283. 3,017,101 - 500,000 - 15,818 = 2,501,283. Gross vs netted intra-column transfers; no fix.
